questions.q: Which is the longest railway platform in India?
questions.explain: Gorakhpur railway platform is the longest in India at 1,366 meters.

questions.q: What is the full form of RRB?
questions.explain: RRB stands for Railway Recruitment Board.

questions.q: The first railway in India was started in which year?
questions.explain: The first railway ran from Bombay to Thane on 16 April 1853.

questions.q: Which railway zone has the headquarters in Mumbai?
questions.explain: Western Railway HQ is at Churchgate, Mumbai. Central Railway HQ is at CST, Mumbai.

questions.q: What is the maximum speed of Tejas Express?
questions.explain: Tejas Express can reach a maximum speed of 180 km/h.

questions.q: Who is known as the Father of Indian Railways?
questions.explain: Lord Dalhousie is considered the Father of Indian Railways for his role in introducing railways in India.

questions.q: How many zones does Indian Railways have?
questions.explain: Indian Railways has 18 railway zones.

questions.q: What is the gauge of the railway line used in most of India?
questions.explain: Broad Gauge (1,676 mm) is used in most of Indian Railways.

questions.q: The Rajdhani Express runs between?
questions.explain: Rajdhani Express connects Delhi with various state capitals across India.

questions.q: What does NTPC stand for in RRB NTPC?
questions.explain: NTPC stands for Non-Technical Popular Categories in RRB recruitment.

questions.q: Which is the busiest railway station in India by passenger traffic?
questions.explain: Mumbai CST (Chhatrapati Shivaji Terminus) handles the highest passenger traffic.

questions.q: What is the length of Konkan Railway?
questions.explain: Konkan Railway is approximately 756 km long, running along the western coast.

questions.q: The Deccan Queen Express runs between which cities?
questions.explain: Deccan Queen runs between Mumbai (CST) and Pune.

questions.q: What is the full form of IRCTC?
options: Indian Railway Catering and Tourism Corporation
Indian Railway Communications and Technology Corporation
Indian Railway Construction and Transport Corporation
Indian Railway Commerce and Trade Corporation
questions.explain: IRCTC stands for Indian Railway Catering and Tourism Corporation.

questions.q: Which train is known as the Lifeline of Kerala?
questions.explain: Kerala Express connects Delhi with Trivandrum and is considered the lifeline of Kerala.

questions.q: What is the mascot of Indian Railways?
questions.explain: Bholu the Guard (an elephant) is the official mascot of Indian Railways.

questions.q: The Nilgiri Mountain Railway uses which type of technology?
questions.explain: Nilgiri Mountain Railway uses the Rack and Pinion system for steep gradients.

questions.q: What is the shortest railway zone in India?
questions.explain: Kolkata Metro is the shortest railway zone in India.

questions.q: Which railway station has the most platforms in India?
questions.explain: Howrah Junction has the most platforms (23) among Indian railway stations.

questions.q: What is the fare class code for Sleeper Class in Indian Railways?
questions.explain: SL is the fare class code for Sleeper Class. 3A is 3-tier AC, 2A is 2-tier AC, 1A is First AC.
